description.zh:
是否开启双因子。取值：

- **true**：开启
- **false**：不开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable two-factor authentication. Valid values:

- **true**: yes

- **false**: no

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

> Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh: 双因子认证成功后，后续登录堡垒机时跳过双因子认证的时间，取值范围为0~168，单位（小时）。0表示不跳过，每次都需要双因子认证。
description.en: The duration within which two-factor authentication is not required after a user passes two-factor authentication. Valid values: 0 to 168. Unit: hours. If you set this parameter to 0, the user must pass two-factor authentication every time the user logs on to the bastion host.

description.zh:
双因子验证码发送方式。当EnableTwoFactor为true时，至少要指定一种方式。取值：

- **sms**：短信
- **email**：邮箱
- **dingtalk**：钉钉工作通知
- **totp**：手机OTP令牌
- **gmusbkey**：国密USBKEY
description.en:
The method used to send a verification code for two-factor authentication. If EnableTwoFactor is set to true, you must specify at least one method. Valid values:

- **sms:** text message.

- **email**: email.

- **dingtalk**: notice in DingTalk.

- **totp**: one-time password (OTP) token.

- **gmusbkey**: SM-based USB key.

title.zh: 修改堡垒机实例的双因子配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-instance-two-factor --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --enable-two-factor true --two-factor-methods sms --skip-two-factor-time 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ModifyInstanceTwoFactor --region cn-hangzhou --EnableTwoFactor true --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --SkipTwoFactorTime 1 --TwoFactorMethods sms --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
